description: Uncontrolled Resource Consumption vulnerability in Apache IoTDB JDBC driver. This issue affects Apache IoTDB JDBC driver: from 1.3.3 before 2.0.11. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 2.0.11, which fixes the issue.

An authentication bypass vulnerability exists in Apache IoTDB's Thrift RPC service This issue affects Apache IoTDB: from 2.0.0 before 2.0.11. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 2.0.11, which fixes the issue.

Sensitive information disclosure and manipulation due to improper authorization checks. The following products are affected: Acronis Cyber Infrastructure (ACI) before build 6.0.1-112, Acronis Cyber Infrastructure (ACI) before build 6.1.1-64, Acronis Cyber Infrastructure (ACI) before build 6.2.1-71.
